description: This file defines the Header class used in the report module of the OrangeHRM system. It manages report header columns, supports normalization, and handles metadata.

classes.name: Header
classes.description: Represents the header configuration for reports, with support for columns and metadata.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Header with a list of columns.

methods.name: getColumns
methods.description: Returns the list of columns in the header.

methods.name: setColumns
methods.description: Sets the list of columns, adding each individually.

methods.name: addColumn
methods.description: Adds a single column to the header, validating its type.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Converts the header's columns into an array form for external use.

methods.name: getMeta
methods.description: Returns the optional metadata associated with the header.

methods.name: setMeta
methods.description: Sets the metadata for the header.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a Header object with an array of columns.

methods.name: setColumns
methods.description: Sets and adds multiple columns at once.

methods.name: addColumn
methods.description: Adds a column after validating its type.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Produces a normalized array representation of the header columns.
